project.title: Order 30968 - Carla Miro Vinyals 2023-02-23, Order 35373 - Carla Miro Vinyals 2024-05-29
project.projectDescription: HeLa or HEK293 cells transiently transfected with Galt1-sCGrx1p-HA redox sensor protein. Cells were treated with 0.1 mM IAA for 20 min on ice. The samples are anti-HA magnetic beads with the sensor protein captured from whole cell lysate.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Beads were washed twice with 100 µl of digestion buffer (10 mM Tris, 2 mM CaCl2, pH 8.2) and the wash was discarded. Afterwards 45 µl of digestion buffer and 5 µl trypsin solution (100 ng/µl in 2 mM HCl) was added. Microwave assisted digestion was performed at 60°C for 30 min. Supernatant was collected and remaining peptides were extracted from beads with 50 µl digest buffer and joined with supernatant. Reduction was conducted by adding 1.8 µl TCEP (100 mM) and incubation for 30 min at 30°C. Alkylation was performed by adding 2.8 µl heavy IAA (500 mM) and incubation for 30 min at RT in the dark (heavy IAA: prepared fresh, weight 0.0009 g in 10 µl H2O). Resulting peptides were dried and dissolved in 20 µl MS sample buffer (3% ACN, 0.1% FA).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw LC-MS data was processed using the Skyline Targeted Mass Spec Environment.
